select hrp.*, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'HLS500_ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = to_char(HRP.ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES)) ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES_N, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'FINANCING_LOAN' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = HRP.CREDIT_TYPE) CREDIT_TYPE_N, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'HLS500_PAY_TYPE' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = to_char(HRP.PAY_TYPE)) PAY_TYPE_N, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'EXEMPT_PENALTY_INT' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = HRP.EXEMPT_PENALTY_INT) EXEMPT_PENALTY_INT_N, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM HLS_PRICE_LIST HPL WHERE HPL.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND HRP.PRICE_LIST = HPL.PRICE_LIST) PRICE_LIST_N, (select hbm.bp_name from prj_project_bp pb, hls_bp_master hbm where pb.project_id = hrp.reply_id and pb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and pb.bp_type='MANUFACTURER') bp_name from hls_reply_product hrp
and hrp.reply_id = #{replyId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hls_bp_master_reply hbmr WHERE hbmr.reply_id = hrp.reply_id AND hbmr.latest_flag = 'Y')
AND hrp.reply_product_code like concat(concat('%',#{replyProductCode}),'%')
AND hrp.difinition_name like concat(concat('%',#{difinitionName}),'%')
AND (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master_reply hbmr, hls_credit_line hcl, hls_bp_master hbm where hrp.reply_id = hbmr.reply_id and hbmr.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id and hcl.bp_id = hbm.bp_id) like concat(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%')

select hrp.*, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'HLS500_ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = to_char(HRP.ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES)) ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES_N, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'FINANCING_LOAN' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = HRP.CREDIT_TYPE) CREDIT_TYPE_N, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'HLS500_PAY_TYPE' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = to_char(HRP.PAY_TYPE)) PAY_TYPE_N, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'EXEMPT_PENALTY_INT' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = HRP.EXEMPT_PENALTY_INT) EXEMPT_PENALTY_INT_N, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'RESIDUAL_PRICE_TYPE' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = HRP.residual_price_type) residual_price_type_n, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM HLS_PRICE_LIST HPL WHERE HPL.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND HRP.PRICE_LIST = HPL.PRICE_LIST) PRICE_LIST_N, (select hbm.bp_name from prj_project_bp pb, hls_bp_master hbm where pb.project_id = hrp.reply_id and pb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and pb.bp_type='MANUFACTURER') bp_name from hls_reply_product hrp where exists (select 1 from prj_project p where p.data_type='NORMAL' AND HRP.REPLY_ID=P.PROJECT_ID)
AND (select hbm.bp_name from prj_project_bp pb, hls_bp_master hbm where pb.project_id = hrp.reply_id and pb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and pb.bp_type='MANUFACTURER') like concat(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%')
AND hrp.reply_product_code like concat(concat('%',#{replyProductCode}),'%')
AND hrp.difinition_name like concat(concat('%',#{difinitionName}),'%')
